tei:div.tei:p: (233)༄༅/ gsang skor gyi dbang gi lag len gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so/

"$ (234) oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku// mi 'gyur lhun grub kun tu bzang po dang*// dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal te// gsang skor snyan brgyud dbang gi lag len bri// de la gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal dris byugs par tshangs zur gyi thig gdab la rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i nang ma la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ bar ma la bcu drug /phyi ma la nyi shu rtsa bzhi bris la/ lte ba mthing ka'i shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu/ mtshams dang gzhan rnams mdzes tshon du bskyed la/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar dpal gtor spod dang chang gis brdzis pa'i mtha' bskor du/ chos skyong spyi/ sngags srung*/ gza'/ dam can/ gzhi bdag lnga'i gtor ma dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa bshams te/ slob dpon rang nyid skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed (235)nas/ ā+o yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis stong pa'i ngang las/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo// ye shes kyi me ri me phung dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las 'ja' tshon spel ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ seng ge nyi zla rin po che'i khri la/ dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum sku mdog mthing ga mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brjod nas maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis bh+rūm̐ las 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bskyed pa'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba'i mthar/ rig 'dzin brda ba'i brgyud pa dang*/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rim du rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin du gsal btab la/ rnga dang rol (236)mo'i sgra sgrog cing 'di skad do// hūm̐/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje thabs mkhas ye shes rol pa'i lha// dus gsum rgyal ba rig 'dzin bla mar bcas// chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar sku bzhengs shig

/hūm̐/ ma g.yel ma g.yel rig 'dzin tshogs// ma g.yel ma g.yel yi dam lha// ma g.yel ma g.yel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ma g.yel ma g.yel srung ma'i tshogs// rgyal po'i pho brang gang na yod pa na// yul khams skye bo thams cad de na 'du// bstan pa'i snying po gang na yod pa na// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na 'du// nyi ma'i snying po gang na shar ba der// 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ltar// byang chub sems kyi dgongs klong gsal ba na// zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs kyang de na 'du// nam mkha' stong la lho sprin gtibs pa bzhin// rig 'dzin dam can tshogs kyang de na 'du// rgya mtsho chen po chu bran 'du ba bzhin// ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyang de na 'du// lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin ma g.yel zhig /phyag rgya chen po tshe la dbang ba yi// rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ma g.yel zhig /hūm̐/ nyi ma lta bu'i pho brang nas// chos sku kun bzang yab yum la// 'khor du ye shes rgya mtshos bskor// 'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs// 'ja' tshon 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// longs sku rigs lnga yab yum la// 'khor du byang chub sems dpas bskor// 'dir gshegs= /'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' la// 'khor du nye ba'i sras kyis bskor// 'dir (237)gshegs= /ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas// ston pa dga' rab rdo rje la// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// 'dir gshegs= /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /byang chub 'byung ba'i shing drung nas// gu ru shrī siṃ ha la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /bha seng chen po'i dur khrod nas// gu ru bi ma mi tra la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /bsam yas mchims phu'i dge gong nas// nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs=

/g.yo ru gzang phug pho brang nas// rje btsun blo gros dbang phyug la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /brag dkar rta so'i pho brang nas// gu ru rin chen 'bar ba la// 'khor du= /'di gshegs= /klungs shod zhwa yi lha khang nas// gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /'do le zam kha'i pho brang nas// lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /g.yo ru brag dmar pho brang nas// gu ru shangs ba ras pa la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /g.yu phug gsal ba'i pho brang nas// bla ma zab ston chos 'bar la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /nyang smad chu sgo'i dgon pa nas// dam pa dgyer ston zhig po la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /nyang smad chu sgo'i sman sgang nas// gnyen ston shes rab rtse mo la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs=(238)yon tan sgang gi gnas mchog nas// drin chen sprul sku mchog gnyis la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /'od gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas// bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /rang byung ye shes pho brang nas// rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza la// 'khor du= /'dir gshegs= /lhun grub rig pa'i pho brang nas// kun mkhyen sna tshogs rang grol la// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// 'dir gshegs bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes spyan drangs pas steng gi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon te bdag dang*/ rten gtor bskyed pa dang*/ gnas rnams la dbyer med du byin gyis rlob cing sa gzhi bar snang dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma'i zhing khams su bsam la/ byin dbab pa ni/ rig 'dzin dben gnas so so nas// bla ma bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor du brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// gdug dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thibs// rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo// rol mo mang po di ri ri// sil snyan mang po si li li// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol/

hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// yi dam rgyal ba rigs lnga la// 'khor du sems dpa' bcu drug bskor// gdug dang rgyal mtshan sribs se thib// rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo// rol mo mang po di ri ri// sil snyan mang po si li li// gnas mchog 'di= /sgrub mchog= /hūm̐/ rang bzhin dur khrod so so nas// ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro la// 'khor du dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor// gdugs dang = /rin chen (239)rgyan= /sil snyan mang = /gnas mchog= /sgrub mchog= /bstan pa snying po'i bka' 'khor nas// sngags bdag ye shes stobs ldan la// 'khor du dam can rgya mtshos bskor// gdug dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thibs// rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo// rol mo mang po di ri ri// sil snyan mang po si li li// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang rten dang gnas kyi nam mkha' gang bar dbyer med gcig tu bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul pa ni/ hūm̐/ phyi yi mchod pa rin po che// snang srid rnam dag mchod par 'bul// skye 'gags med par bzhes su gsol// nang gi mchod pa rin po che// 'dod yon sna lngas mchod par 'bul// rgyun chad med par bzhes su gsol// gsang ba'i mchod pa rin po che// dug lnga khong khro mchod par 'bul// 'gro 'ong med par bzhes su gsol// yang gsang mchod pa rin po che// ting 'dzin dgongs klong mchod par 'bul// 'phel 'grib med par bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod nas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa las// rang byung ye shes bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha// kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rig 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// che ba'i rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// mthu stobs dpag med sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*// sgrub mchog rnams la bu bzhin legs skyong ba// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag (240)'tshal bstod// ces sta gon gyi cho ga rnams rdzogs par bya'o// de nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba dngos la gnyis las/

sngon 'gro ni na rag rgyas bsdus gang rung gi skong bshags dang*/ mos gus khyad par can gyis gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la slob bus maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ thal mo sbyar te 'dug pa la// bla mas dam pa'i chos ngos gzung ba ni// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas thugs rje che ba des// 'gro ba sems can gyi don du chos kyi sgo dang*/// /theg pa'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po ston pa las/ theg pa chen po la yang gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis las/ da res 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ston pa lags/ sngags la'ang phyi nang gnyis las/ 'dir nang pa thabs kyi rgyud ston pa lags/ nang ba la'ang bskyed pa ma hā yo ga dang*/ lung a nu yo ga dang*/ man ngag a ti yo ga gsum las/ 'dir a ti ston pa lags/ a ti la yang phyi skor/ nang skor gsang skor gsum las/ 'dir gsang ba'i skor ston pa lags/ de la yang dpe brgyud dang snyan brgyud gnyis las/ 'dir snyan brgyud ston pa lags/ snyan brgyud la yang yi ge yod pa dang med pa gnyis las/ 'dir yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud gsang ba gnad kyi me long zhes bgyi ba ston pa lags/ de la'ang ma smin par smin par byed pa dbang dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir dbang ston pa lags/ de la (241)yang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i dbang gnyis las// lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa zhig bshad la/ gnyis pa dbang dngos la/ sngon 'gro slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gnyis las/ slob ma la 'jug pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed thun mong pa ni/ slob mas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sems can kun la phan don du// bla med byang chub sems bskyed do// zhes pa gsum dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes pa lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba ni// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// sems can kun la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// sdom pa thams cad bzung bar bgyi// rigs lnga'i dam tshig rjes bzung ste// rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa// dam tshig rdzas rnams bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje slob dpon nyid dang ni// dkon mchog gsum po mi spang zhing*// rdo rje spun sring smad mi bya// theg pa dman la mi brnyas zhing*// sems can kun la 'tshe ba spang*// chos dang gang zag mi smod cing*// 'khrul ba'i bya ba yang mi bgyid// bstan pa smad par mi bya zhing*// bsam gtan sgom pa (242*)dkrugs mi bya// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig mchog /sku gsung thugs las mi 'da' zhing*// bskyed rdzogs 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*// bla mas gsungs pa ji bzhin bsgrub// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyungs rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod do// gsum pa dam tshig la gnas par bya ba gnyis las/ dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ thod pa nas dam chu blud la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu// 'das nas dmyal khams me yis sreg /bsrung na dngos grub bla na med// de bas dam tshig rdo rje mchog /snying la bzhag pas thub par gyis// oṃ sa ma ya pañca a mṛ ta hrīḥṭha/ zhes brjod do// dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ bla mas/ kye/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig nyon// rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir zhugs nas// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa dang*// dam chos bsgrub par dam chos shig

/ji ltar sngags kyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa thams cad bzung bar bgyi// dam rdzas rnams dang sngags kyi tshig /dbang bskur ma thob mi rnams la// gsang ba bsgrag par mi bya zhing*// bstan pa kun la gnod pa spang*// gang gis rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dngos grub mchog la reg par bgyi// zhes brjod par bya'o// bzhi pa rjes su gzung ba la gnyis las/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu// (243)'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// nyon mongs me yis gdungs pa la// thugs rje'i brlan gyis bsil bar mdzod// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzang por 'dir// bdag ni yang dag bzhugs par gsol// zhes pa gsum dang*/ yang 'di skad do// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la// bdag gi gus pas gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi// dbang bskur nang du zhugs lags pas// rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs kyi// a ti'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol// zhes gsum brjod do// gnyis pa gnang ba sbyin pa ni// bla mas/ e ma bu khyod skal ba bzang*// rdzogs chen dkyil 'khor bstan par bya// sems kyi rtog pa kun sel cing*// 'jig rten 'ching ba kun grol gyis// 'di la spang blang tha snyad bral// rigs dang rgyud rnams sbyong ba yis// lus ngag bde ba'i rten yin pas// deng nas brtsams te slar ma ldog /ces brjod do// lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ slob ma kun langs la/ thal mo snying gar sbyar mig btsum// dad gus bskyed la/ bla ma'i spyi bor rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam rigs lnga dang*/ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i sprin phung gtibs te byon pa rim pas gsal btab la dbyer med du bstim zhing*/

so so'i mtshan dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing*/ spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pas bdug go /des ni (244)ye shes phebs so// don gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ slob ma skyil krung bcas la rdo rje sems dpa' sgom du bcug pa'i spyi bor gtor ma bzhag la/ sngar gsal btab pa'i bla ma/ yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum po'i rnam pa dang*/ slob dpon rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba rnams kyi dbu'i gtsug gtor nas 'od zer dkar po grangs med pa byung*/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku yi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis lus khengs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ dbang rtags su rnam par snang mdzad tshon gang bas dbu brgyan par bsams la/ hūm̐/ sku yi dbang bskur lus la bskur// lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// sku yi dngos grub thob gyur te// bum dbang rin chen rdzogs par shog /oṃ kā ya ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ gtor ma mgrin par gtugs te/ lha dang bla ma'i mgul nas 'od zer dmar po byung slob bu'i ngag la phog /ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam la/ hūm̐/ gsung gi dbang bskur ngag la bskur// ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// gsung gi dngos grub thob gyur te// gsang dbang rin chen rdzogs par shog āḥwā ka ghu ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ gtor ma snying gar gtugs la/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing ga byung*/ slob ma'i snying gar phog /yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus khengs/ bde ba chen por ro gcig tu bsam ste/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi dbang bskur sems la (245)bskur// yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// thugs kyi dngos grub thob gyur te// shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog /hūm̐ tsit+ta pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas/

bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che rdzogs chen rig pa'i rtsal dbang ni/ sems nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang du klong nas rig pa'i rang mdangs zang thal chos kyi sku de rang rdzogs thig le nyag cig tu ngo sprod de/ dbang rin po che'i 'khor lo las/ sngon rgya gar yul gyi grong khyer ser skya zhes bya bar/ rgyal po'i phru gu ltad mo la phyin nas/ rgyal bu rkang 'khyams te sprang po lta bur song*/ de nas dus nam zhig na/ blon pos ngo shes nas/ dbang bskur bas 'khor 'bangs mnga' 'og tu 'dus so// de bzhin du thog ma'i sangs rgyas dang*/ sems can 'od mthong ba las/ rang ngo ma shes 'khrul bar shar// de la ngo sprod bstan pa ni// rang rig ye shes dbang bskur bas// 'khor ba'i mtshan ma rang sar grol// zhes pas te/ dpe rgyal bu/ bon rang rig /rtags da lta'i shes pa rang mdangs rang shar ba 'di sangs rgyas su nges shes bskyed la ngo sprad do// de nas tshogs la rol zhing gtor ma dngos grub tu shes pas longs spyod la/ bsngo ba smon lam rdo rje'i glu/ lhag ma'i gtor ma/ bkra shis dang bcas pa'i grangs yongs su rdzogs par bya'o// yi ge snga mar cung zad ma tshang ba rnams dang*/ cung zad gab pa rnams bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar lhag chad med par bkod pa'o// dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam zhugs te// 'gas kyang ma 'bad sus kyang ma rtsol bar/ (246)don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por shog /snyan brgyud yi ge med pa'i sgo 'byed/ dbang rin po che gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis bkod pa'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
